name: sim04
description: Crossed simulation on the four real PUMAs whose rare-race tract cells rest on about one sampled case (4703000, 4702300, 4702900, 4701900): truths drawn from two statewide-support (epsilon 0.01) posteriors with the tau prior sd 3, the Gaussian rows of tn08_long_state_prior3 (gauss) and the Poisson rows of tn10_long_state_prior3_poisson2 (poisson), 3,200 long-HMC draws each; a 1-in-8 survey of each truth and a simulated PUMS subsample of the PUMA's real sample size, as sim02; each truth fitted on the statewide support (its simulated PUMS plus the PUMA's real out-of-PUMA records) with Gaussian rows (sim04_fits_gauss.json, puma+prior3) and with Poisson rows (sim04_fits_poisson.json, puma+prior3+poisson2). No pools: a truth may hold out-of-PUMA records that are also in the fits' support, the same for both fits (sim02_common.py).
